reviewedClinicalClaims.limitations: Only 18 selected patients from a related lineage; the degree of epidemiological independence is uncertain. Two patients had polymicrobial bacteremia. Sampling and genomic controls reduce some contamination concerns but do not by themselves exclude a shared clinical or sampling source. Reported deaths cannot establish organism-attributable mortality, a population fatality rate or a treatment effect.

reviewedClinicalClaims.limitations: One patient with structural lung disease; no frequency estimate. The earlier isolate was not confirmed as P. sputorum; persistent colonization by the same strain is speculative. The paper did not perform 16S confirmation and reports a platform/library combination inconsistently. Some alternative etiologies were not definitively tested, and treatment response is not species-specific proof. No inference that HTLV-1 caused immune dysfunction or predisposed to infection in this individual.
